report.spark_min_rule: floor(min over the rows of {EPA's spark, base, base + comp, base + comp - cold}) - 1 (amendment D3)
report.spark_max_rule: ceil(max over the rows of {EPA's spark, base}) + 1

report.tie_rule: the highest gate (amendment D2), then the lowest rpm_lo, then the lowest rpm_hi

depth_edge.invariant_source: the contract's all-row lambda clip floor (lambda_clip_floor.floor: round(min(0.70, the deepest lambda over every row - 0.01), 3), held-out and Initial rows included; amendment C1, a C13 disclosure)

highest_map_rows_skipped.why: no calibration air (no meter or lambda)

resolution.statement: the five starts choose the basin at the declared tolerances; the one that stopped lowest is polished at TOLERANCES['S4_polish'] and the polished point is the frozen one (polish: its departure from that start); the in-sample stage is evaluated there

report.d13: amendment D13: an E1a miss on stoichiometric hot rows at form A is read as a burn/FMEP residual that no form B-D can act on (mistake 20); it is reported, with S4's residuals per line and per population, and never used to justify a form. The ladder still moves by the contract's criterion (section 2.4).
